claim.description: the report line carrying the verified-at claim (quoted evidence)
the report line carrying the unlocatable claim (quoted evidence; no question judges it)

instructions.question: How does the code in `claims[{i}].section` relate to the claim in `claims[{i}].claim`?
instructions.how_to_read: `claims[{i}].claim` is quoted evidence from a report. Judge only what the numbered code lines show.

criteria.contradicts: The code states the opposite of the claim or implies it is false
criteria.says_nothing: The code does not address what the claim asserts, either way
criteria.supports: The code states the claim or directly implies that it is true

notes: On downgrade, every claim indexed by detail.flagged, and every entry in detail.also_flagged (file or line not found), is marked unverified, and the reading agent re-checks it before it enters the design or a ruling. If no claim is readable, the state fails its schema (claims minItems 1) and ask fails open. The caller then treats every unreadable claim as unverified itself.
